retrievalProfile.description: A central sharp subject contrasted against a faded, ghostly secondary figure within a hazy, warm-toned environment featuring heavy lens flares and distressed textures.
excludeWhen: sharp focus on all subjects is necessary

recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic composition featuring a sharp, full-body male subject in the foreground looking away, paired with a desaturated, semi-transparent female figure in the background. The scene is unified by a warm, dusty sepia palette, intense golden lens flares, and a gritty, film-grain texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground subject vs. ghostly background figure
Sharp central focus vs. hazy peripheral flares
Warm sepia tones vs. dark clothing silhouettes
Textured grain vs. smooth light gradients
coreInvariants: Double exposure transparency on the secondary figure
Heavy atmospheric haze and dust particles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is centered vertically, full-body, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The sharp silhouette of the primary subject's head and shoulders against the lighter haze.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top text, moves down the primary subject, follows the lens flare to the secondary figure, and ends at the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of hazy, textured negative space on the left and right margins to emphasize isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted sepia and warm grey (background and atmosphere)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the light leaks.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Slight erosion on edges to match background grit
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both title and artist name to maintain thematic consistency.
graphicDevices: Horizontal text alignment at extreme top and bottom

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight and modern feel.
Open counters and clean geometric lines work well with wide tracking.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned portrait of a man in a black t-shirt and cap, standing in a hazy environment. Include a semi-transparent 'ghost' figure of a woman behind him. Add heavy golden lens flares at the bottom and left, and apply a dusty, film-grain texture over the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text at the top and bottom center. Use wide tracking (letter spacing) and an off-white color with a slight grainy texture to match the background.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly warm/sepia?
Is the text tracking wide and uppercase?
Are there visible dust and grain textures?

mustRedesign: Any logos on the subject's clothing
Specific brand names in the text
Identifiable facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is centered and widely spaced
Confirm lens flares don't obscure the primary face
recipe.reuseFormula: Central Subject + Ghostly Secondary Layer + Sepia Haze + Wide-Tracked Geometric Sans
